summary: One-line fix wraps `variable_attrs[0]` in `dict()` so combine_attrs='override' returns a copy instead of a reference, exactly matching the issue's root cause and consistent with the no_conflicts/other branches. Minimal, correct, mergeable.

issues.description: dict() is a shallow copy, so nested/mutable attr values remain shared between source and merged product. Matches behavior of the sibling combine_attrs branches, so consistent and not a regression — minor caveat only.
